faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to commonly asked questions.
faq.a1: Yes! Basic tools like Edit PDF, Merge PDF, Split PDF, Compress PDF and PDF to Image are completely free. The Pro plan gives access to advanced tools like OCR and PDF to Word.
faq.q2: Is my file safe? Is it uploaded to a server?
faq.a2: Your files are NOT uploaded to any server. All processing happens 100% in your browser. Your PDF files never leave your device.
faq.q3: What is the maximum file size supported?
faq.a3: Free users can process files up to 10MB. Pro users can process files up to 100MB.
faq.a4: Open a PDF file, use the toolbar to add text, draw, highlight, sign, stamp and more. Click 'Save PDF' to download.
faq.q5: Can I add a signature to a PDF?
faq.a5: Yes! Use the 'Sign' tool in the editor. Draw your signature on the pad, then place it on the PDF.
faq.q6: What is the difference between Free and Pro plans?
faq.a6: The Free plan includes all basic tools with a 10MB limit. The Pro plan (RM19/month) adds OCR and PDF to Word, with a 100MB limit.
faq.a7: Yes, PDFFix works on all devices. The best experience is on a desktop computer for detailed editing.
faq.a8: PDFFix focuses on PDF operations. We support PDF to Image (JPG/PNG) and PDF to Word (Pro plan).
